items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We wrote, “Unless It’s You,” and we just now wrote something, just finished a song called, “Life in My Eyes,” brand new song. “Emily,” was written for…

ctx.x: So let's get back to, Sandpiper, or Emily, first of all.
Emily was great and it literally started my songwriting career, have we talked about that, did we talk about that last night?
